name: Northbound Diner
description: Scratch-made breakfast and lunch in Ferndale, Michigan. This is sample content for the Summit site template.

faq.question: Do you take reservations?
faq.answer: No, seating is first come, first served. Parties of eight or more can call ahead.

faq.question: Is there parking?
faq.answer: Free street parking on Example Ave and a public lot one block east.
